description: One-DGX Spark Inkling 2 Mini (26.4B total, 3.4B active looped mixture of experts) as vcruz305's SAGE REXL3 4.23 bpw pack (15.1 GB, two trunk shards plus the pack's own MTP draft head) on TabbyAPI over vcruz305's exllamav3 fork (the Inkling2Loop architecture, its decode kernels and MTP drafting) and vcruz305's TabbyAPI fork (the Inkling 2 message format, so reasoning and tool calls arrive parsed), as in vcruz305's dgx-spark kit (MIT). Upstream's measured set: 24,576 tokens of context in one FP16 KV pool, one stream at a time (a second concurrent stream leaves the fast decode path and the draft), prefill chunks of 2,048 tokens, speculative decode with the MTP head, and a sampling fallback of temperature 1.0 for clients that send none. Upstream keeps 24,576 as its context ceiling because larger values are untested there; the pack itself is trained for 262,144. The pack carries a vision tower, but upstream's launch leaves TabbyAPI's vision loading off and did not test images, so this recipe serves text only. The Inkling 2 message format in the TabbyAPI fork refuses grammar-constrained output (JSON schema, regex or a forced tool choice). Expected memory: upstream measured about 22 GiB of host memory used at these settings (MemAvailable 104.5 to 82.1 GiB with the draft on), which the declared peak follows; it fits one Spark and is an estimate until tried here. Upstream has no container: its setup.sh builds a host venv with torch 2.13.0 (CUDA 13.0) and compiles the fork's extension; this recipe performs the same installation in its own image with the fork locked to the kit's pinned commit 10a85129 (1.6.7.post1) and the TabbyAPI fork to a2898191. The pack is under Apache 2.0 and TabbyAPI is AGPL-3.0; both are shown for information.
title: Inkling 2 Mini SAGE REXL3 4.23 bpw ExLlamaV3 single Spark (vcruz305)
